feedback: Approved, unchanged. This candidate has the same design as iteration 10, which raced at score 257.78, the best verified score (iteration 5 was 160.41). Iteration 10 moved all five sensors forward from y = 0.03 to y = 0.05 m and left the controller at its iteration 5 values. Its per-track results were oval 8/20 finishes with max_error 0.0542, s-bend max_error 0.0631 and slalom 0.0627. Oscillation stayed at or below 0.27 on every track. Gain changes (kp 3.0 in iteration 4, kd 0.45 in iteration 6, ki 0.10 in iteration 8) and line-loss direction (iterations 5 and 7) all failed to beat iteration 5, so this is the final design and no further edits are useful. The Optimizer should not change any field in this final iteration.
requested_changes: Submit the design unchanged: all five sensor_positions y = 0.05 m, sensor_size 0.016, kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.3, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], line_loss search_right.
